scenes.text: Have you ever felt like history just doesn't add up, and what if the year isn't actually 2024, but we are living in 1727?
In the 1990s, a German historian proposed the Phantom Time Hypothesis, claiming that three medieval rulers conspired to fabricate three entire centuries of history.
They allegedly invented historical figures like Charlemagne and forged official documents to jump ahead in time so they could rule during the year 1000 AD.
While mainstream historians completely reject this idea, it makes you question how much of history is set in stone, so drop your thoughts in the comments!
